scope: MCP fixture-engine teardown: 26 test files and the opt-in QA harness
change: One test-only stopEngine helper replaces 27 duplicate shutdown blocks. It clears the losing deadline timer and exit listener. After the existing eight-second SIGTERM grace period it SIGKILLs only its owned child, awaits actual exit, and throws a visible fixture timeout failure.

runner.command: JASPER_REQUIRE_ORACLES=1 JASPER_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/chromium pnpm exec vitest run apps/mcp/test/sound-motion.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=<report>
runner.conditions: Same worktree, Node/pnpm, fixture inputs and flags. Agent test jobs serialized with /tmp/jasper-validation.lock. Fresh Vitest process per sample; installed dependencies/OS cache warm. Shared host load and import/analysis variance remain uncontrolled.

representativeFileWallSeconds.interpretation: Final samples are lower, but intermediate samples were higher and imports/startup dominate. No attributable Vitest or CI speedup is established from these small shared-host samples.

realChildLifetimeProbe.observation: Without a test runner force-closing the worker, the old losing timer retains the parent process for eight seconds after child exit. The shared helper releases it; this is a resource-lifetime measurement, not CI runtime.

validation.realIntegrationAndPacks: 12 tests passed after consolidation of graceful shutdown
validation.deadline: A real child ignoring SIGTERM is dead with SIGKILL after the same eight-second grace period and stopEngine rejects with the expected visible timeout failure.
validation.healthyChild: A real normally terminating child exits promptly without a losing timer; stopping the already exited child again is a no-op.
validation.limits: The opt-in QA/Remotion suites were not rerun for the helper-only change; the integrated root gate remains the full-suite validation owner.

contractSource: User test-infrastructure cleanup requirement and AGENTS.md §0: child/process failures must be visible and work must not remain dead-but-running.
